**Finding submitted — deviation (LD), fallback-level redline.**

- **What is responsive:** Section 14.4.2 (p0792) expressly makes the Section 14.2 termination amounts payable by PB "in lieu of any claim for damages" — the hallmark of Customer-payable liquidated damages. The underlying formulas are 300% of Development Costs (14.2.1 breach, 14.2.2 at-will, 14.2.5.2, 14.2.7), 150% (14.2.6, 14.2.8.1), and Development Costs plus 25% p.a. interest on a mere JSC disagreement (14.2.10).
- **Not flagged:** the Section 6.7 Buy-Out Payments (an elective prepayment right benefiting us) and Section 6.4 default interest — ordinary commercial mechanics, not liquidated damages.
- **Target level:** fallback. Deleting every 14.2 formula to reach the preferred no-LD result would require collateral rewrites of the funding economics, so we made one surgical edit to the exclusive-remedy proviso, which already carries a "Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary" override so the retained formulas are displaced, not contradicted.
- **Element coverage:** all three fallback elements (only an early-termination fee, capped at three months of fees, sole liquidated amount payable by Customer) are carried by the single operation, validated with `ok:true` and a passing minimality gate.
